from cyhole.jupiter import Jupiter
from cyhole.jupiter.client import GetSwapOrderParams, PostSwapExecuteBody
from cyhole.jupiter.interaction import JupiterClient

# Initialize Jupiter API
jupiter = Jupiter()
client = JupiterClient(jupiter)

# Token mints: SOL and USDC on Solana
SOL_MINT = "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112"
USDC_MINT = "EPjFWaJfNqLpzLEVEVnW2WJG9WZdGzfNhJ7pv1W6XUz"

# Example wallet address (replace with actual address)
WALLET_ADDRESS = "YourSolanaWalletAddressHere"

# Amount: 1 SOL in lamports (1 SOL = 10^9 lamports)
AMOUNT_IN_LAMPORTS = 1_000_000_000

# Step 1: Request a swap quote (order)
swap_order_params = GetSwapOrderParams(
    inputMint=SOL_MINT,
    outputMint=USDC_MINT,
    amount=AMOUNT_IN_LAMPORTS,
    userPublicKey=WALLET_ADDRESS,
)

print("Requesting swap quote...")
swap_order_response = client.get_swap_order(swap_order_params)
print(f"Quote obtained: {swap_order_response.outAmount} USDC received")

# Step 2: Execute the swap
swap_execute_body = PostSwapExecuteBody(
    swapRequest=swap_order_response.swapRequest,
)

print("Executing swap...")
swap_execute_response = client.post_swap_execute(swap_execute_body)
print(f"Swap executed: {swap_execute_response.swapResult}")
